notes: All trainable models are fit anew; no legacy checkpoint or prediction reuse.
ARIMA parameters fitted once per candidate and filtered causally at each issue time.
Prophet fitted once per seed; calendar-only target predictions shared across horizons.
Persistence and ARIMA deterministic results are not duplicated over seeds.
GRU final output is linear; clipping remains evaluator-only.
Long-feature LightGBM has up to 168h lags and calendar features, unlike 24h models.
